lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of 3 to 5 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the primary blobs at roughly 90-degree angles, creating a rectilinear pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges traversing the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity upper edges and low-intensity shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the trailing edge and base of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least five distinct elongated Echeneidae (remora) silhouettes clustered in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral fin.
